primary.title: The Interpretation of Dreams
primary.author: Sigmund Freud
primary.rationale: Freud's seminal work, laying the foundation for psychoanalysis. It is widely available and a cornerstone of his writings.

primary.title: The Ego and the Id
primary.author: Sigmund Freud
primary.rationale: A key text in Freud's later structural model of the psyche. It is a foundational work for understanding his developed theories.

primary.title: Civilization and Its Discontents
primary.author: Sigmund Freud
primary.rationale: Explores the inherent conflict between individual desires and the demands of civilization. A widely read and influential work.

secondary.title: Freud: A Life for Our Time
secondary.author: Peter Gay
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and highly regarded biography of Freud by a prominent historian, offering deep insights into his life and work.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Freud
secondary.author: Richard Wollheim and James Hopkins
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars providing diverse perspectives on Freud's theories and their impact.

secondary.title: Freud's Patients: A New History of Psychoanalysis
secondary.author: Ethan J. Kuperman
secondary.rationale: Offers a fresh perspective on Freud's clinical work by examining his case histories and their significance.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are foundational texts by Freud. Secondary sources are scholarly overviews and biographies published after 1976.
